title: Plan → implement with dirty files, no-commit choice, and full review
steps: Start with a dirty working tree (unrelated unstaged files).
Run lodestar-plan for a small change; record rigor full.
Run lodestar-implement; choose not to commit when asked.
Confirm plan body stayed immutable and no git add -A.
Complete full-tier review path without housekeeping rewrite of history.
Record before/after run cost (model calls, tokens when exposed, elapsed, shell commands, questions) and artifact bytes.
